text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The final day of summer camp—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
I wonder if all the ponies have boarded—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And... Oh, dear.
Where are Pandora and Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec, I had some free time so I went for a run!
And now I'm late~! I'm sooo sorry!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wah, me too! I didn't want to waste any time,
so I was running a lap around the mountain trail!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's right. Once summer ends,
you'll both be heading into the Shuka Sho, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I see you have polished yourself
to perfection as well!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: W-Well? The throne of the next queen belongs to me!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, seriously! Don't think of me
as the same as before, Kawakami-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt, but get on the bus quickly!
Everyone's waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Well!
I certainly won't lose, not ever!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And with that, I shall take my leave!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, no fair!
I was here first!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the scorching summer came to an end—
and autumn was about to begin.
